notes.title: New Content Updates for Ascendant Hearts (Windows)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The Steam version has been updated with a new build that contains new additional content which is developed with a different engine (Unity) as part of the console port that we did a few months ago.

As the port only supports Windows, this update is only available for Windows users. Mac / Linux users will only be able to play on the old legacy build (Renpy) which will still work fine.

If you are on windows and you want to access the legacy build, here are the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/595730/discussions/0/1734384427838166660/]instructions.[/url]

Note that the old build save files will not work in the new build as it is developed using a different game engine.

Content Updates 
[list][*] New Artwork (CGs / Sprites / BGs) 
[*] New Music and SFXs 
[*] Additional Story Content 
[*] New UI 
[/list]

You can visit the [url=https://visualnoveler.com/ascendant-hearts]game's website[/url] for more details about the new content updates.
